mutants.name: notify-event-drops-disabled-check
mutants.why: notify_event must refuse all events when notifications.enabled=false; dropping the _notifications_enabled guard lets pushes fire even when the user has disabled them

mutants.name: event-default-unknown-true
mutants.why: unknown events must default to False (the ruled-closed table; change 1); returning True makes every undeclared event page, which inverts the silence-is-safety invariant

mutants.name: invert-dedupe-gate
mutants.why: the dedupe gate must suppress a repeat push within the window; inverting the condition sends on repeat and suppresses the first — every first page is eaten and every repeat fires

mutants.name: drop-ownership-guard
mutants.why: ownership suppression must fire when plan_scoped=True and a live session owns the plan; dropping the guard sends the push even when a session is attended

mutants.name: ignore-plan-scoped-flag
mutants.why: non-plan-scoped events (class_hold, disk_low, watcher_down) must bypass the ownership check regardless of session attendance; dropping plan_scoped from the condition subjects them to suppression

mutants.name: watcher-key-4tuple
mutants.why: notify_watcher_down must use a 3-tuple key (machine, '-', 'watcher_down') so mark_machine_live's pop hits the same slot; a 4-tuple key never matches the pop and the dedupe persists after mark_machine_live

mutants.name: mark-live-pops-wrong-key
mutants.why: mark_machine_live must pop the same 3-tuple key that notify_watcher_down writes; popping a different key leaves the dedupe entry intact and the second episode is silently eaten
